file.title: File

minutes_est.title: Minutes Est
minutes_est.description: Approximate on-floor VIDEO minutes from track presence (includes stoppages; with court coordinates, time tracked more than 4 ft outside the lines, e.g. on the bench, is not counted).

px.title: Px
px.description: Pixel position in the copy of the film the coach clicked on (CourtCalibration.video_width x video_height); the server and the GPU rescale it to the film's own resolution.

homography_available.title: Homography Available
homography_available.description: True when positions and shot zones are in court feet (coord_mode == "court"): a pipeline homography, the coach's calibration, or court positions from the pipeline's court model (OpenHoopVision sends positions, not matrices). Shown as "Court mapped".

FastScoutNotes.description: ``GET /export/fastscout-notes``: what to check before pasting, and the team numbers typed in by hand.

FilmResult.description: Response of upload ``complete`` and ``video-url``: the game plus the auto-started job.

team_id_map.title: Team Id Map
team_id_map.description: Pipeline team id -> side. Empty = auto.

video_url.title: Video Url
video_url.description: Remote source URL when the film was not uploaded.

has_tracking.title: Has Tracking
has_tracking.description: tracking.json.gz (the GPU results) is in the game folder, so a REANALYZE can start. scout.db reads it from the disk with every game.

worker_last_seen_s.title: Worker Last Seen S

max_upload_bytes.title: Max Upload Bytes
max_upload_bytes.description: SCOUT_MAX_UPLOAD_GB in bytes, for the upload page.

external_id.title: External Id
external_id.description: Processor handle, e.g. the Modal FunctionCall id.

side.description: Team running the play (offense) or playing the defense.

possessions_pct.title: Possessions Pct
